title: Render CJK command composition and draft
changes: Render console draft and preedit glyphs absent from Inter with the bundled Droid Sans Fallback font, preserving the primary Latin appearance.
Carry the original Droid font notice and copyright record in portable, release and generated game packages.
validation: Windows GNU menu/runtime and packager builds passed; Wine tests distinguish CJK glyphs and preserve Latin rendering. A Cangjie GUI showed 日 in preedit and committed draft, accepted è and preserved guest state. Synthetic portable package tests and release notice staging passed.
limitations: Fallback covers characters present in the bundled font, not every Unicode glyph. Wine/Xvfb simulated input only; native Windows, physical input, broader IMEs and DBG2-14 capability guards remain unverified.
